description: Draws line, area, bar, scatter, bubble, histogram, box, pie, donut, heatmap and combined charts from rows or CSV and JSON files as SVG and PNG images, as a Chart maker agent and a plugin.

inference_slots.description: Turns the user's data and request into a chart with the charts tool. Any capable profile; one that accepts images also checks the picture.
inference_slots.name: chart_maker

name: charts

bind_dir.description: The data file to chart, or the folder holding it; written only by a call that sets save

plugins.description: Draws a chart (line, area, stacked area, bar, scatter, bubble, histogram, box, pie, donut, heatmap, combo) from rows or a CSV or JSON file and returns it as an image with a text description, or saves it as SVG and PNG files.

agg.description: How rows with the same x or category combine: sum (default), mean, count, min, max or median. Heatmaps default to mean.

bins.description: Histograms: a number of bins from 1 to 200, or auto (default).

center.description: Heatmaps: the value drawn as the neutral colour of a diverging scale.

chart.description: The chart type: line, area, stacked_area, bar, stacked_bar, horizontal_bar, scatter, bubble, histogram, box, pie, donut, heatmap or combo.

colors.description: Series colours as hex strings like "#1f77b4"; the default palette is colour-blind safe.

data.description: Inline data: {"columns": [...], "rows": [[...]]} (the data_tables result), a list of objects, or CSV text with a header line. Use this or path.

file.description: The data file inside the folder named in path.

format.description: Number format for values and the y axis, like ",.0f", "$,.2f", ".1%", "~s" or "{,.0f} units".

horizontal.description: Bar charts: draw the bars horizontally.

legend.description: Legend placement: auto (default), right, bottom, top, left or none.

line.description: Combo charts: the columns drawn as lines (on the right axis).

line_axis.description: Combo charts: draw the lines on the right axis (default) or the left one.

output.description: both (default), svg or png. A tool call shows the PNG; svg returns the SVG text instead.

path.description: The CSV or JSON data file, or the folder holding it; a relative path starts at the working folder. Use this or data.

path_original.description: Set by the host to the real path named in path; leave it out.

save.description: Write the chart into the folder named in path: a base name like "chart" writes chart.svg and chart.png, or give {"svg": "a.svg", "png": "a.png"}. path must be a folder.

scale.description: PNG pixel density, 0.5 to 4 (default 1); width x height x scale squared is at most 16 million pixels.

series.description: Column whose values split the rows into one series each (long-format data); then y is one column.

size.description: Bubble charts: the column that sets each bubble's size.

sort.description: Category order: none (data order, default), x, x_desc, value or value_desc.

value.description: Heatmaps: the column that sets each cell's colour.

x.description: Column for the x axis, the categories or the pie labels. Default: the first column.

x_format.description: Format of the x axis labels: a number format, or on a time axis a date pattern like "%b %Y".

x_label.description: X axis title; the column name by default, an empty string for none.

x_scale.description: X axis: auto (default), linear, log, time or category.

y.description: Value columns, one series each; default: every numeric column. For a heatmap, the column on the other axis.

y2_format.description: Number format of the right axis.

y2_label.description: Combo charts: title of the right axis.

y2_scale.description: Combo charts: right axis, linear (default) or log.

y_format.description: Number format of the y axis; overrides format.

y_label.description: Y axis title; the column name by default for one series, an empty string for none.

y_scale.description: Y axis: linear (default) or log; a log axis needs values above zero.

plugins.name: charts
